title: Morning Brief — Tue 24 Nov

stories.board: Pentagon scolds Canada over military spending
stories.headline: The US military says Canada is not doing enough to defend North America
stories.what: The Pentagon (the US defence department) put out a sharp statement saying Canada is falling short as a defence partner. It pointed to Canada's military spending and its review of whether to keep buying F-35 fighter jets.
stories.why: Canada and the US guard North America together, and this adds new strain to an already tense relationship.
stories.sides: Outlets on both sides report the same facts; the disagreement is between Washington and Ottawa, which has been rethinking how much it relies on US-made weapons.

stories.board: Israel split over new Iran strike
stories.headline: Netanyahu wants to hit Iran again soon, but army chiefs see no rush
stories.what: Ynetnews reports PM Netanyahu is pushing for a quick new strike on Iran, while army chief Eyal Zamir says there is no urgent threat right now. President Trump says the US may restart strikes after New Year if talks with Iran fail.
stories.why: A new strike could restart the war with Iran and pull the US back in.
stories.sides: Netanyahu says critics are playing politics; some US officials, Eisenkot and Liberman suspect the push is tied to Israel's coalition (team that runs the government) fight.

stories.board: Big Thanksgiving storm heads up US East Coast
stories.headline: A strong storm will hit the US East Coast on American Thanksgiving
stories.what: A coastal storm will move from the US Southeast to New England Wednesday and Thursday, with 1 to 4 inches of rain and wind gusts over 80 km/h. Some coastal flooding is likely, and wet snow may fall in high areas.
stories.why: Millions of people are travelling, so flights and roads could be delayed, which matters for anyone flying from Toronto to the US this week.

quick_hits: Update: stocks are falling this morning after Monday's huge jump, with Nvidia down about 5 percent before the market opened.
Israel's Eisenkot and Netanyahu's Likud party talked for two hours about a shared government with no deal, and will meet again.
A Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine hit an apartment building, killing 2 people and hurting about 40.
big_picture: Allies are arguing: the US with Canada over defence, and Israel's leaders with each other over Iran.
